text: じつは……　レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ　ちょっと　ついて　きてくれ！

structure.jp: レッドに　おねがいが　あるんじゃ
structure.en: I have a favor to ask of Red

structure.jp: ちょっと　ついて　きてくれ！
structure.en: come along with me for a moment!

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んじゃ is the old-man form of んだ (のだ), which gives an explaining tone. おねがいが　あるんじゃ = 'the thing is, I have a favor to ask'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb shows the action moves along toward or with the speaker. ついて　きて = 'come following me'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: てくれ is the blunt order form of てくれる, 'do it for me'. ついて　きてくれ = 'come along with me, will you'.
